name: Amazon
tagline: World's largest online marketplace, logistics network and retail-media engine
facts: NASDAQ: AMZN; AWS is separate sheet
Andy Jassy; Stores led by Doug Herrington
FY26 ASSPL rev ₹34,967 cr; group loss ₹2,793 cr

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Lowest prices, vast selection, fastest delivery: the flywheel where more selection drives traffic, sellers and lower cost structure.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Regionalised fulfilment and same-day network cut cost-to-serve; paid units growth (+17% Q2 2026) funds price investment.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Prime bundle plus owned logistics plus first-party shopper data feeding a $68B+ high-margin ads business.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: AI shopping (Rufus, Alexa+), rural same-day, and quick commerce: Amazon Now in India with $3B committed by 2030.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is Amazon now an ad company that sells goods? Does rising ad load erode the customer-obsession promise?

customers.who: Urban households buying frequently, value speed
customers.pain: Need trusted fast delivery and easy returns across everything
customers.why: Free fast shipping, Prime Video, deals and Prime Day lock in habit

customers.who: Price-sensitive buyers, India tier-2/3, deal hunters
customers.pain: Want lowest price without fake products or delivery uncertainty
customers.why: Huge selection, A-to-z guarantee, low-price stores like Haul and Bazaar

customers.who: SMBs, D2C brands, Indian MSMEs, exporters
customers.pain: Need demand, logistics and payments without building own infrastructure
customers.why: Largest buyer base, FBA fulfilment, Global Selling to 18+ marketplaces

customers.pain: Need closed-loop measurement proving ad spend drives sales
customers.why: Sponsored ads at point of purchase plus Prime Video and DSP reach

customers.who: DSP owners, Flex drivers, Indian kirana partners
customers.pain: Want steady earnings and volume with flexible work
customers.why: Massive daily package volume and Amazon-supplied tech, routing and vans

products.name: Rufus

products.name: Haul / Amazon Bazaar

portfolio.key_metrics: Paid units, conversion, delivery speed, selection in stock, repeat rate
portfolio.guardrails: Return rate, counterfeit complaints, contribution margin per unit, CSAT

portfolio.key_metrics: Members, renewal rate, spend per member vs non-member
portfolio.guardrails: Cancellation complaints, FTC dark-pattern exposure, delivery cost per member

portfolio.guardrails: Seller fee burden, organic result quality, ad load per search page

rows.how: Retail margin on goods; low margin, high volume
Referral commission, FBA fulfilment and storage fees
CPC sponsored ads, DSP impressions, Prime Video ads
Annual or monthly Prime fee; Video add-ons
Whole Foods and Fresh store margins

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Online stores ~37% of sales, 3P services ~24%, ads ~10%, subscriptions ~7%; AWS ~18% (separate sheet).

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Shoppers pay for goods and Prime; sellers and brands pay fees and ads, which carry most profit.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Retail near break-even per unit; ads and 3P fees fund free shipping. Regionalisation lowered cost-to-serve.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Ads on Prime Video, AI shopping, rural same-day, low-price stores, India quick commerce.

bullets.label: India note
bullets.text: Amazon India FY26 losses grew 48% to ₹2,793 cr as Now and Pay burn cash.

friction: Search pages crowded with sponsored listings
Fake reviews and counterfeit risk on 3P listings
Rising seller fees push prices up
Prime cancellation flow drew FTC action
India: slower than quick commerce for daily needs

competitors.label: Global retail
competitors.text: Walmart, Temu, Shein, TikTok Shop, Alibaba

competitors.label: Quick commerce
competitors.text: Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, Flipkart Minutes

competitors.label: Retail media
competitors.text: Google, Meta, Walmart Connect, Flipkart Ads

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Logistics scale, Prime habit and shopper data no rival matches globally

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Antitrust (FTC), India FDI rules, losing Indian MAUs to Flipkart
